crossref_verified.title: Conduction Modelling Using Smoothed Particle Hydrodynamics

reference.formula: T(x,t) = T_cold + (T_hot - T_cold)/2 * erfc(x / (2 sqrt(alpha t)))
reference.primary: Carslaw, H.S. & Jaeger, J.C. (1959) Conduction of Heat in Solids, 2nd ed., Oxford University Press, Ch. II (linear flow of heat in the infinite and semi-infinite solid), §2.6: two semi-infinite media initially at different uniform temperatures, put in contact -- the erf/erfc similarity solution used here as the reference.
reference.secondary: Cleary, P.W. & Monaghan, J.J. (1999) Conduction Modelling Using Smoothed Particle Hydrodynamics, J. Comput. Phys. 148:227-264, doi:10.1006/jcph.1998.6118 -- source of the SPH conduction operator.
reference.provenance: Reference values are *computed* from the closed form by code (tensorsph.heat_conduction.contact_temperature), not transcribed from any table, so no number is hand-copied. The secondary citation's bibliographic fields (journal, volume, pages, DOI) were verified programmatically against Crossref (see crossref_verified). The book's equation numbering was not machine-verified (no library access from the sandbox): the formula itself is validated here by a Crank-Nicolson finite-difference solver, by its limits and by self-similarity.

parameters.kernel: 1-D cubic spline (M4), support 2h, h = 1.3 dx, eta = 0.01 h
